title: Argentinian Grilled Corn Bake
description: A hearty, savory corn bake inspired by Argentinian flavors, perfect as a side dish or light meal.

ingredients.name: tender bread
ingredients.amount: 1 loaf, crust removed and torn into 1-inch pieces
ingredients.notes: Any type of bread works, but a crusty bread is best

ingredients.name: butter
ingredients.notes: You can use more or less to your liking

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.notes: Use a light hand when seasoning

ingredients.name: black pepper
ingredients.notes: Use a light hand when seasoning

ingredients.name: fresh parsley
ingredients.notes: Optional, but adds a pop of color and freshness

instructions: In a large bowl, combine the corn, bread, melted butter, and grated cheese. Mix well to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the casserole is heated through.
Remove from the oven and garnish with chopped parsley, if desired.
